source_review.notes: Checked twelve current primary documentation sources from Apache Spark, Apache Flink, and Trino. All twelve URLs returned HTTP 200 on the retrieval date. Sources support repartition and shuffle semantics, shuffled-hash versus sort-merge strategy separation, adaptive skew handling, partition counts, hash-join spilling, partitioned versus broadcast distribution, and co-located join property reuse.

evidence: Reviewed left/right multisets L and R, serialized payloads B_L and B_R, destination count P, partition function p, buckets L_j and R_j, multiplicities m_x and n_x, reusable fractions f_L and f_R, and skew split count S.
Checked join predicate/equality, partition compatibility, logical bucket identity, physical placement, build/probe roles, and local hash versus sort-merge algorithms remain distinct.
Checked snapshot, plan, partition epoch, side, producer, destination, attempt, segment, accepted winner, skew map, and output commit identities are consistent.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Logical multiset semantics, distribution, local execution, physical locality, and resource accounting are not conflated.

evidence: Executed repartition-join-accounting with Python 3.14.4 and reproduced four inner rows, six left-outer rows, left bucket counts (1,2,1,0), and right bucket counts (1,2,0,1).
Recomputed full logical movement as 600+250=850 GiB and partially reusable movement as 0.65(600)+0.80(250)=590 GiB.
Recomputed 800 GiB across 4,000 destinations as a 204.8 MiB mean while confirming a 90 GiB hot key remains at least 90 GiB in one ordinary bucket.
Recomputed exercises as 1.7 TiB symmetric versus 1.1 TiB reusable movement, and a 60-way hot-key plan with 1,800 routed right rows and 27,000,000 required pairs.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The executable fixture validates deterministic toy routing, multiplicity, null behavior, and arithmetic only; it is not a hash-quality, shuffle, spill, concurrency, or performance benchmark.

evidence: Verified inner-join decomposition L join R equals the multiset union over local L_j join R_j when matchable keys co-locate and routing/completeness premises hold.
Verified key x contributes m_x n_x inner pairs, so partitioning and local build structures must preserve duplicate multiplicity.
Checked logical movement B_L+B_R and reusable movement (1-f_L)B_L+(1-f_R)B_R exclude physical amplification explicitly.
Verified one-side hot-key salting with complete opposite-group replication covers every pair exactly once, whereas independent two-side salting omits cross-salt pairs.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Mean bucket size and logical movement are accounting models, not safety bounds or exact physical I/O/network predictions.

evidence: Reviewed empty and one-sided-empty inputs, one partition, more partitions than rows, unique/duplicate/all-equal keys, null/null-safe keys, collisions, composite keys, coercion, Unicode/collation, NaNs, residual predicates, and all major join semantics.
Reviewed count, byte-width, build, probe, output, placement, and adversarial-hash skew; giant rows/groups; low parallelism; and fixed-overhead explosion at high P.

Reviewed disk full, short/corrupt/missing/duplicate blocks, fetch timeout, network partition, worker/shuffle-service loss, cancellation, retry, speculation, adaptive split/coalesce, and mixed partition epochs.
Reviewed mixed writer/hash versions, stale bucketing metadata, unauthorized tenant/region placement, telemetry leakage, retention/holds, and deletion races.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Relational correctness, contract compatibility, placement locality, resource safety, exchange completeness, retry fencing, and governance can fail independently.

evidence: Traced every input row through pinned normalization/partitioning, one destination, immutable producer block, accepted manifest, validated fetch, local join, attempt-scoped output, and one committed winner.
Checked matchable keys co-locate under one partition epoch while hash collisions still require full equality and residual-predicate evaluation.
Checked complete left/right bucket evidence precedes unmatched outer/semi/anti decisions and duplicate lists retain exact multiplicity.
Checked memory, disk, network, descriptors, tasks, metadata, spill recursion, skew replication, output buffering, retries, and cleanup are bounded and charged.
invariant_checking.notes: An authoritative accepted manifest, not a file name or equal bucket count, distinguishes compatible complete input from empty, missing, corrupt, stale, or losing output.

evidence: Reviewed the ten-step audit from relational contract and source properties through distribution choice, pinned epoch, sizing, exchange, completeness, local semantics, commit, measurement, and deletion.
Checked soundness and completeness of bucket-local inner join plus multiset multiplicity and accepted-attempt uniqueness.
Checked outer/semi/anti extension requires complete opposite buckets and unique unmatched-row ownership under skew replication.

Reviewed counterexamples for equal bucket counts, average-size safety, more-partitions monotonicity, hash-equals-key, naive salting, empty/missing equivalence, spill universality, and generation mixing.
proof_review.notes: Correctness is conditional on exact compatible routing and complete accepted inputs; performance and capacity claims require observed distributions and enforced bounds.

evidence: Audited uses of exact, compatible, complete, accepted, immutable, deterministic, trusted, reusable, local, expected, estimated, mean, bounded, and safe.
Confirmed the multiset theorem states routing, equality, completeness, and attempt premises rather than claiming partition labels prove correctness.
Confirmed engine-specific Spark/Flink/Trino behaviors are sourced and hints/configuration are not presented as portable guarantees.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Co-partitioning, salting, adaptive skew handling, spill, and locality claims retain their required conditions and limitations.

evidence: Reviewed proposed measurements for rows/bytes/distinctness/width, contract reuse, locality, per-bucket tails, producer blocks, compression/spill/files/descriptors, fetch/retry, build/sort/hash, duplicate/output groups, backpressure, and attempts.
Confirmed no universal partition count, target bucket size, hash, seed, spill threshold, skew threshold, salt count, build side, local algorithm, retry limit, or retention period is prescribed.
Checked estimated versus actual, mean versus maximum, logical versus physical movement, local versus remote bytes, and successful versus failed/losing attempts remain separate.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Production decisions require representative key/frequency/width/output distributions, exact runtime and connector contracts, topology, concurrency, storage, failure, threat, and policy evidence.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed repartition join as a distribution contract distinct from local shuffled-hash or sort-merge execution, spanning symmetric/one-sided/co-located paths, reusable physical properties, key/null/multiplicity semantics, movement and partition-count costs, skew repair, exchange completeness, retry, adaptation, security, and lifecycle.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed practical property discovery, filter/projection pushdown, partition selection, hash/sort spill, hot-key detection and salting, physical locality, immutable manifests, accepted attempts, mixed-version rejection, metrics, fault injection, regulated placement, and cleanup. Internal practitioner-oriented review only.

pedagogical_review.notes: Verified progression from relational and partition contracts through movement/reuse, local algorithms, skew, failure, validation, and governance. Ten examples and five complete exercises cover symmetric/reused bytes, false compatibility, average-versus-tail size, multiplicity, low parallelism, correct salting, outer ownership, spill fallback, proof, and co-partition audits.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external Spark, Flink, or Trino maintainer, database/query-optimization or distributed-algorithms researcher, runtime/network/storage/performance specialist, connector/table-format owner, adversarial-security reviewer, privacy/legal/records authority, affected-tenant reviewer, accessibility specialist, or certification review is claimed.
